name: nam_mobile
observations: Flutter mobile app for Network Asset Management Audit Assessment
Tech stack: Flutter 3.8.1 + Dart, Firebase, GetX, Hive, flutter_map
Feature-based modular architecture with ViewModel pattern
40+ HiveType models with generated adapters in responses.models.dart
Uses Get.put() for initialization and Get.find() for retrieval pattern
Obx() widget for reactive UI updates with .obs properties
Core services: api.service.dart, hive.service.dart, location.service.dart, storage.service.dart, network.service.dart
Feature folders: essentials (auth, home, profile, inspection, activity, assets, app, init), commons (map, marker, card, chip, form)
Inspection feature has deep nested screens: devices (odp, otb, towers, fishbone, closure, backbones), detail, connect, update, types, main
flutter_map for OpenStreetMap integration with marker clusters, floating markers, tile caching
Matches Clean Architecture pattern: features contain presentation (vm/ui/widgets)
Core layer has services (api, hive, location, storage, network)
Uses GetX dependency injection and reactive state as recommended
Top-level dirs: android/, ios/, assets/, lib/, scripts/
lib/features/essentials/ - main app features (activity, app, assets, auth, home, init, inspection, profile)
lib/core/services/ - centralized services (api, hive, storage, location, network)
lib/main.dart - entry point with Firebase, Hive, GetX setup
Hive adapters: lib/core/services/hive.service.dart registers all models
Service classes are singleton-style, injected via GetX
Theme: lib/core/themes/core.themes.dart with Themes class (static colors)
Refactored to GetxService singletons with .to pattern
Consumer files: 7 ViewModels + core.requests + main.dart updated
main.dart: Get.put(ApiService()); Get.put(StorageService()); before service usage

name: GetX Pattern
observations: Get.put(VM()) in UI screen file for initialization
Get.find<VM>() in widget files to retrieve instance
Reactive state with RxBool, RxString, RxInt (.obs)
UI updates via Obx(() {}) wrapper widget
onInit() lifecycle override for initialization logic
Standard pattern: one .vm.dart + one .ui.dart per feature
AppVM uses permanent: true for app-wide singleton
Best practice: Get.put() for initialization at screen entry, Get.find() in widgets
Reactive state with .obs and Obx(() {}) wrapper
Controller disposal with Get.delete<Controller>() when needed
ViewModel pattern: Reactive state via Rx<Type> and .obs
Instantiation: Get.put(VM()) in screen, Get.find<VM>() in widgets
AppVM uses permanent:true for app-wide singleton

name: contacts-backend
observations: Implemented bulk delete and bulk update labels operations
Uses inArray for efficient bulk database operations
Implemented contact merge functionality with POST /contacts/merge endpoint
Merge operation consolidates emails, phones, labels, and documents from duplicates to primary contact
Validates all contacts belong to same tenant before merging
Soft deletes duplicate contacts after merge
Implemented Redis caching with @Cacheable and @CacheEvict decorators
Updated cache TTL from 60 seconds to 5 minutes (300000ms)
Created custom @Cacheable decorator for caching method results
Created custom @CacheEvict decorator for cache invalidation
Created CacheInterceptor to handle caching logic
Applied @Cacheable to ContactsService.findAll with key pattern: contacts:list:${tenantId}:${JSON.stringify(query)}
Applied @Cacheable to LabelsService findAll with key pattern: labels:list:${tenantId}
Applied @Cacheable to DocumentsService listDocuments with key pattern: documents:list:${tenantId}:${contactId}
Cache module exports Cacheable, CacheKey, and CacheEvict decorators
